title: Fingerprint canonical sheet geometry
description: Produce a deterministic geometry fingerprint from canonical normalized geometry while ensuring an independent catalog-data edit creates a new sheet-layout identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonicalization includes every normalized geometry field that changes label boundaries
Equivalent imperial and metric inputs produce identical canonical geometry and fingerprints
Source formatting, display units, timestamps, provenance, and verification labels do not affect the geometry fingerprint
Any canonical geometry change changes the fingerprint
Editing catalog identity or provenance independently creates a new `SheetLayout` identity rather than rewriting the existing identity
Fingerprint output uses a documented stable algorithm and encoding

steps.details: Specify field order, numeric representation, radius-state treatment, UTF-8 encoding, and exclusions for a versioned canonical geometry payload.
Serialize only validated normalized geometry with the canonical encoder and hash it using one stable browser-supported algorithm behind a domain-facing function.
Store fingerprint algorithm/version and value on each revision and verify the value when records are decoded or imported later.
Route independent product/catalog identity changes through a clone-as-new-layout operation rather than changing the existing stable identity or geometry history.
Test equivalent-unit inputs, reordered source object keys, disclosure-only edits, each geometry-field edit, and catalog identity edits against expected fingerprint and identity behavior.

technicalNotes: Do not fingerprint JavaScript's incidental object key order or locale-formatted numbers.
Version the canonical encoding so future schema migrations can preserve auditability.
